decision.message: The esp32_bmp280_v1 family board does not support a dedicated humidity sensor on the PCB. It only includes the BMP280 sensor for pressure and die temperature measurement, not ambient temperature or humidity.

clauses.text: The board must measure both humidity and pressure, with a dedicated humidity sensor on the PCB.
